title: Spaceship Lounge Furnishing Planner
description: The user is an interior architect tasked with furnishing a spaceship hallway into a luxury lounge. They must place, rotate, duplicate, and customize SheenChairs along the corridor, adjusting lighting warmth and camera walkthrough points to finalize the design before submitting it for approval.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a spaceship lounge furnishing planner. Load space_ship_hallway.glb as the environment centered at origin and SheenChair.glb as the furniture piece. Camera: Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 8) looking down the hallway with OrbitControls. Lighting: Add one warm-white AmbientLight (intensity 0.3) and two PointLights (one at each end of the hallway, intensity 1.0, color #ffe0b2). Interactions (7 steps with validation): 1) PLACE CHAIR: Click a 'Place Chair' button to spawn a SheenChair clone at the camera's forward position projected onto the floor (y=0). Validate that no more than 6 chairs exist simultaneously. 2) SELECT CHAIR: Raycasting click on any placed chair highlights it with an emissive outline (set emissive color on its materials). Only one chair selected at a time. 3) MOVE CHAIR: While a chair is selected, arrow keys move it along X/Z axes in 0.3 unit increments. Validate the chair stays within hallway bounds (clamp X to [-3,3], Z to [-12,12]). 4) ROTATE CHAIR: Press R to rotate the selected chair by 45-degree increments around Y axis. Display current rotation in a HUD overlay. 5) CHANGE LIGHT MOOD: A dropdown with options 'Warm', 'Cool', 'Neon' changes both PointLight colors (#ffe0b2, #b2d8ff, #ff69b4 respectively) and updates a HUD label showing current mood. 6) CAMERA PRESET WALKTHROUGH: Three buttons ('Entrance', 'Mid', 'End') smoothly animate the camera (using a lerp over 60 frames) to preset positions along the hallway Z axis at height 2. Validate the animation completes before allowing another preset click. 7) SUBMIT DESIGN: A 'Submit' button validates that at least 2 chairs are placed and triggers a confirmation overlay showing chair count, their positions rounded to 1 decimal, and selected light mood. Add a minimal HUD panel (HTML/CSS overlay, top-right) showing chair count, selected chair rotation, and light mood. Use GLTFLoader from three/addons. Ensure all models load before interaction is enabled with a loading screen.
